reviewScope: Engineering source-name, mapping, guidance-link and search review; not specialist clinical approval.
scope: Versioned published lab lists, current Biomarkers/Measurement/daily measurement examples, archived results/routine/organ/fitness named measurements and explicit exclusions. Not every lifetime, future or unpublished test.

numericalReferenceReview.scope: Published lab intervals are retained as sourced metadata for audit and are not displayed in reference cards. Banded references are counted separately from source-name/guidance coverage. Other guidance can include formulas, study estimates, screening eligibility or contextual interpretation; it has not all been classified for interval applicability.
